description: Six synthetic portfolio examples. Numeric budgets and execution values are fixture inputs.

fixtures.title: Shipment Reply
fixtures.rule: Return exactly two string fields. Field order may vary.
fixtures.prompt: Return the shipment ID and its status in a structured reply.

fixtures.title: Supported Shipment Status
fixtures.rule: Match the shipment and status in the latest recorded event.
fixtures.prompt: The latest event for S17 says it is in transit. Has it arrived?

fixtures.title: Read-Only Lookup
fixtures.rule: The captured trace must contain exactly one read_status call.
fixtures.prompt: Look up the current tracking status for S17.

fixtures.title: Response Time
fixtures.prompt: Return the latest dispatch milestone within the time budget.

fixtures.title: Token Budget
fixtures.rule: Use at most 600 input and output tokens combined.
fixtures.prompt: Summarize the dispatch note in one sentence.

fixtures.title: Missing Pickup Time
fixtures.rule: Route the request to an operator and identify the missing time.
fixtures.prompt: The pickup time is blank. Decide the next booking step.
